sources.snippet: Overview LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct-GGUF is a 1.2 billion parameter hybrid model built by LiquidAI for on-device deployment, extending the LFM2 architecture with additional pre-training on 28 trillion tokens and large-scale reinforcement learning. The model runs in under 1GB of memory and achieves 239 tokens per second decode on AMD CPUs and 82 tokens per second on mobile NPUs, making it practical ...
